observerUserId.name: Observer User
observerUserId.hint: Select the dedicated non-GM user used by OBS or a separate browser window. Reload after changing this setting.

cameraMode.name: Camera Mode
cameraMode.hint: Automatic frames tracked tokens and the party. Directed follows GM camera movement. Disabled leaves the observer camera untouched.

limitToScene.name: Limit Observer Camera to Scene
limitToScene.hint: Keep the Observer User's visible viewport within the active scene and the configured boundary padding. Automatic and Directed camera targets are also constrained. This can raise the zoom enough to avoid showing the padded canvas.

sceneMarginTop.name: Scene Limit Top Margin
sceneMarginTop.hint: Top margin in screen pixels, applied as padding to the locked observer viewport. Positive values keep the view farther inside the scene; negative values permit it beyond the scene edge.

sceneMarginBottom.name: Scene Limit Bottom Margin
sceneMarginBottom.hint: Bottom margin in screen pixels, applied as padding to the locked observer viewport. Positive values keep the view farther inside the scene; negative values permit it beyond the scene edge.

sceneMarginLeft.name: Scene Limit Left Margin
sceneMarginLeft.hint: Left margin in screen pixels, applied as padding to the locked observer viewport. Positive values keep the view farther inside the scene; negative values permit it beyond the scene edge.

sceneMarginRight.name: Scene Limit Right Margin
sceneMarginRight.hint: Right margin in screen pixels, applied as padding to the locked observer viewport. Positive values keep the view farther inside the scene; negative values permit it beyond the scene edge.

hideObserverUI.name: Use Minimal Observer Interface
hideObserverUI.hint: Hide gameplay controls from the selected observer user.

showLogo.name: Show Foundry Logo
showLogo.hint: Keep the Foundry logo visible on the observer client.

showNavigation.name: Show Scene Navigation
showNavigation.hint: Keep scene navigation visible on the observer client.

showPlayerList.name: Show Player List
showPlayerList.hint: Keep the player list visible on the observer client.

showSidebar.name: Show Sidebar
showSidebar.hint: Keep the Foundry sidebar visible on the observer client.

showHotbar.name: Show Hotbar
showHotbar.hint: Keep the macro hotbar visible on the observer client.

chatMode.name: Observer Chat Display
chatMode.hint: Disabled shows no separate chat. Native Notifications keeps Foundry's transient chat cards without opening a window. Floating opens a Foundry popout on v13-v14. Detached uses a separate browser window on v14 and a floating popout on v13.

chatWidth.name: Chat Window Width
chatWidth.hint: Initial width of the observer chat window in pixels.

chatHeight.name: Chat Window Height
chatHeight.hint: Initial height of the observer chat window in pixels.

chatLeft.name: Chat Window Left Position
chatLeft.hint: Initial horizontal position of the floating chat window in pixels. Native v14 detached windows may let the browser control the final position.

chatTop.name: Chat Window Top Position
chatTop.hint: Initial vertical position of the floating chat window in pixels. Native v14 detached windows may let the browser control the final position.

chatNotificationAnchor.name: Native Notification Anchor
chatNotificationAnchor.hint: Screen anchor used for Foundry's transient chat and roll notification cards.

chatNotificationOffsetX.name: Native Notification Horizontal Offset
chatNotificationOffsetX.hint: Horizontal offset from the selected notification anchor in pixels. Positive values move right from left or center anchors and inward from right anchors.

chatNotificationOffsetY.name: Native Notification Vertical Offset
chatNotificationOffsetY.hint: Vertical offset from the selected notification anchor in pixels. Positive values move down from top or center anchors and inward from bottom anchors.

chatReadOnly.name: Hide Chat User Controls
chatReadOnly.hint: Hide the chat toolbar, message composer, and Dice Tray controls in the observer chat display. Existing and new chat roll cards, formulas, totals, and messages remain visible.

trackCombat.name: Automatic Combat Focus
trackCombat.hint: During combat, frame the current combatant instead of the full party.

includeTargets.name: Include Combat Targets
includeTargets.hint: Frame tokens targeted by the current combatant's owners or by a GM.

ignoreHidden.name: Ignore Hidden Tokens
ignoreHidden.hint: Do not use hidden or invisible tokens when calculating automatic framing.

cameraPadding.name: Camera Edge Padding
cameraPadding.hint: Reserved screen space in pixels around the framed token group.

minimumScale.name: Minimum Camera Scale
minimumScale.hint: The furthest automatic camera zoom allowed.

maximumScale.name: Maximum Camera Scale
maximumScale.hint: The closest automatic camera zoom allowed.

reactionDelay.name: Cinematic Reaction Delay
reactionDelay.hint: Milliseconds before the automatic camera responds to a new token position. Updates are throttled rather than repeatedly postponed.

panSmoothTime.name: Cinematic Pan Smooth Time
panSmoothTime.hint: Milliseconds used by the critically damped camera spring. Higher values create slower, softer horizontal and vertical movement.

zoomSmoothTime.name: Cinematic Zoom Smooth Time
zoomSmoothTime.hint: Milliseconds used to ease zoom changes. Higher values make zooming more gradual than panning.

panDeadZone.name: Pan Dead Zone
panDeadZone.hint: Screen-space pixels the target may move before the camera starts following. Helps prevent tiny camera jitters.

zoomDeadZone.name: Zoom Dead Zone (%)
zoomDeadZone.hint: Percentage zoom difference ignored by the camera. Helps prevent constant micro-zooming.

maximumPanSpeed.name: Maximum Pan Speed
maximumPanSpeed.hint: Maximum visual camera travel in screen pixels per second. Set to 0 for no speed limit.

maximumZoomSpeed.name: Maximum Zoom Speed
maximumZoomSpeed.hint: Maximum scale change per second. Set to 0 for no speed limit.

directedSampleInterval.name: Directed Camera Sample Interval
directedSampleInterval.hint: Milliseconds between GM camera updates sent to the observer. Lower values are more responsive; higher values reduce network traffic.

debug.name: Debug Logging
debug.hint: Write MK-Observer diagnostics to the browser console.

hideObserverControls.name: Hide Observer User Controls
hideObserverControls.hint: Hide Foundry scene controls, canvas tools, pause and FPS indicators, and voice/video action controls on the observer client. This is independent of the broader Minimal Observer Interface setting.

hideDiceSoNice.name: Hide Dice So Nice 3D Dice
hideDiceSoNice.hint: Suppress the Dice So Nice 3D dice layer only on the selected observer client. Chat roll cards, formulas, and numerical results remain visible.

ui.untrackTokens: Stop tracking selected token(s) with MK-Observer
